card.name: Linking words after loss or crushing
card.fires_on: Small linking words such as "of", "to" and "for" right after "loss", "due" or "potential" in preparation and handling instructions. Also some commas in lists and a few partway-through-name spots.

modes.label: Loss of potency
modes.description: The word "of" after "loss" in stability or compatibility statements.
modes.example: causing precipitate formation and a loss<< of>> potency.

modes.label: Crushing warnings
modes.description: Linking words after "due" or "potential" in warnings not to crush tablets.
modes.example: Do not crush tablets due<< to>> the potential for increased rate of absorption,

modes.label: List comma
modes.description: A comma ending an item in a list of factors that affect anesthetic dose.
modes.example: the vascularity of the tissues<<,>> the number of neuronal segments to be blocked

card.writes: It seems to push toward words about loss, absorption and exposure that come after the linking word.
card.plain: It fires on the little word that comes just before a statement about losing potency or altered drug release.
